'''Taia''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Private/Legends|private]] serving in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. She participated in the [[Battle of Corellia]] as part of [[Battalion/Legends|Battalion]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Mericci]]'s detachment. However their unit was pulled out along with the rest of Imperial military following the Empire's defeat. Taia and the rest of Mericci's unit made a temporary stop at the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] while they were awaiting redeployment.
